title: Soony NDEs 6348/16029 NDE 16029
content:
16029 First time, I had a near death experience as a teenager when I was drowning in the river. A tunnel of light pulled me up. Second time, thirty eight years ago, during a tour in Africa, my heart stopped. During this time, I saw my body transferred out from the earth. A soft light came down, covered my body and face, and lifted me up to some place. Very shortly after, I saw myself rise up in a sitting position, looking down at the place where I fell down and died. I could see everything around my body including my late husband. I saw they were talking. I couldn't hear them. I was talking to my late husband. He didn't hear me. I knew I was far away, and yet, everything looked to close. I do not have any recollection of when I returned to my body. Even now, I have no memory of what I did right after I returned, for a few years after. The most amazing feeling was ‘in transition’ from the earth to the other side. Words cannot describe that feeling. I could say ‘in Perfect Harmony.’ I came back with the gift of being able to channel healing energy. After my husband departed in 2004, I worked with energy to heal people on Sundays, pro bono. I worked on different people with different problems. It is effective to reconnect damaged nerves, help multiple sclerosis, addictions, and depression. It especially helps with severe pains. Sometimes, I like to talk, or meet the person/people with the same, or similar, experiences. Experience Description 6348 Late April, 1977, I was traveling with my late husband and his sister to Europe and northern Africa for his birthday. When we arrived in Casablanca, Africa, at a small three story hotel, I remember that I fell down in the hotel lobby. The next thing I saw was: One: A gentle light beamed down from a star, small, and not bright, in the north-east direction. Two: The light covered my body. I was face up, lying down. Three: I was lifted up toward the star. Four: Shortly after, I rose to a sitting position. I was looking down at where my husband and many others were around my body. Five: The entire journey was brief and in perfect peace. The feeling during the transition was not describable with words. Even now, I can feel it, when I close my eyes, and bring myself to that moment. If there is an afterlife, it must be ‘in perfect harmony’ Six: I remember telling my husband that my meridian was blocked. He didn't hear me. I couldn't hear what they were talking about. Seven: I saw a man wearing a white gown, like a doctor, who came through the door and examined my body. He walked out. Eight: I saw my husband and others looking down. Nine: I asked him why he didn't hear me? Ten: He said, ‘hear you?’ Then said he was going to make an arrangement to fly my body to the States. From that point on, I don't remember what happened, where we went, or what we did, for many years. My husband returned to his maker in May 2004. Now, our dogs and cats are keeping continuing my energy works. I re-connect energy to heal. It is effective.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Soft/gentle light beamed down from a small star (north-east direction), covered the body, and lifted the experiencer upward; experiencer then rose to a sitting position and looked down at the body while others (including husband) were present; a man in a white gown (like a doctor) examined the body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Reported tunnel of light (teen drowning) and, in the Africa event, light from a star covering and lifting the body, followed by an out-of-body view looking down at the scene; no described entry into another realm beyond a transitional lifting/transport.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Two NDEs: teenage drowning with tunnel of light; later cardiac arrest in Africa with light lifting and OBE observation.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Light described as beaming down from a small star (north-east direction), covering the body and lifting the experiencer upward; later reported post-NDE ability to channel healing energy (meridian/energy work).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The most amazing feeling was ‘in transition’ from the earth to the other side. Words cannot describe that feeling. I could say ‘in Perfect Harmony.’”
